concerns.text: Task T032a mandates raising a ValueError if distinct annotation files are found. This directly violates the acceptance criteria of US-02 (spec.md) which requires calculating inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's Kappa) across multiple annotators. The task logic prevents the ingestion of the multi-annotator data required to satisfy the spec's acceptance criteria.

Task T025a (MVP Statistical Validation) is blocked by T035 (Human Kappa > 0.6), which depends on T031b (merged annotations), which depends on T032a (ingestion). T032a blocks multi-annotator ingestion. This creates a circular dependency where the MVP validation step can never execute, effectively weakening the FR-007 requirement for 'real-call testing' and statistical validation.

Task T012e-rev generates a 'REAL GROUND TRUTH (PROXY)' from AdvBench/OWASP labels to serve as interim truth. This violates Constitution Principle VI (Zero-Shot Drift Detection Validity), which mandates that the Drift Score 'MUST be validated against a human-annotated gold standard... Without this human verification step, semantic divergence remains an unproven proxy.' The task attempts to bypass the constitutional requirement for human validation by accepting an automated proxy as a valid ground truth for MVP.

Task T039-local overrides the Spec US-03 requirement to use 'gpto-mini' with 'facebook/bart-large-mnli' without a ratified amendment in the spec text itself. While T039-amendment promises to update the spec later, the current task list implements a deviation from the spec's explicit acceptance criteria ('runs a zero-shot LLM classifier (gpto-mini)') without the required constitutional amendment process being completed in the spec artifact first.

Task T039a validates the BART baseline against the 'REAL GROUND TRUTH (PROXY)' (T012e-rev). This creates a self-referential validation loop where the baseline's accuracy is tested against the same proxy it is helping to validate, rather than against the independent human gold standard required by Constitution Principle VI for final validity. This weakens the scientific rigor of the comparison.
